title: skills + ADR-0015/0062: teach the code-defined datasource credential route (OS_DATASOURCE_<NAME>_PASSWORD) once #28208 lands
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filing gate: ② governed text made stale by in-flight work. PR #28208 (#27687, the maintainer's option 5 ruling 6525963988) adds a code-defined datasource's credential route: `OS_DATASOURCE_<NAME>_PASSWORD`, read at connect, behind the host switch `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS`. The dev named these governed texts and did not edit them, because they are governed paths. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 and not dispatched. **Blocked-by: #28208.** Start only after it merges, and teach exactly what landed.

## Stale texts (as named by the #28208 dev)

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md` ~:63, "Credentials — fail-closed": teaches only `external.credentialsRef` and the secret store. It should add the code author's route and the switch, with its default on in `os serve` / `os start` and off in library compositions. It should also carry the trust note: any installed package can declare a datasource of any name and so read the matching variable.
- ADR-0015 §10 and its D7 note: the credential binding prose.
- ADR-0062 D3, "Credentials resolved at connect via `SecretBinder`/`ICryptoProvider`": the derived env slot is a second resolution source at that same point, between the connector borrow and the factory.

## Wanted

One PR that brings these three texts in line with what #28208 shipped, with no `#NNNN` in skills text. Both `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**` are governed (Tier H), and the skills token ratchet applies: pay by deleting duplicate text in the same file.

Blocked-by: #28208
